<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10–35 ppm) are at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice), 22.80 ppm, 21.35 ppm, and 19.20 ppm. Counting each carbon represented by these signals gives a total of five CH₃ carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains five methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
